attack_techniques: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Security Support Provider (T1547.005)
attackers_goals: Gain clear text passwords and persistency in the network.
description: Security Support Provider (SSP) exposes a number of callbacks to be invoked during certain authentication and authorization events. An attacker may register SSP to try and gain access to clear text passwords.
investigative_actions: Audit the specific key values to verify that the additional values are trusted.
name: Uncommon Security Support Provider (SSP) registered via a registry key
required_data: XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
